channel.description: Recent content in Laboratory Assignments on MIT OpenCourseWare

item.title: Lab 1: Coulomb and Viscous Friction
item.description: Introductory lab assignment on the frictional characteristics of the rotational plant.

item.title: Lab 2: Calibration of Lab System Components
item.description: Lab assignment on calibration of lab system components.

item.title: Lab 3: Construction of a Proportional Velocity Controller
item.description: Lab assignment on construction and testing of an op-amp differential amplifier, use of the differential amplifier as a proportional velocity controller for the 2.004 rotational plant, measurement of the transient response characteristics, and the steady-state behavior of the closed-loop controller, and comparison of the measured performance with predictions based on the pre-lab exercise.

item.title: Lab 4: Closed-loop Performance of a Proportional Velocity Controller
item.description: Lab assignment on the 2.004 digital PID Controller, detailed study of the effect of controller gain on transient and steady-state behavior, and study of the ability of the closed-loop system to “follow” time varying commands.

item.title: Lab 5: Elimination of Steady-state Error Using Integral Control Action
item.description: Lab assignment to investigate the elimination of steady-state error through the use of integral (I) and proportional plus integral (PI) control, and to compare your experimental results with a Simulink digital simulation.

item.title: Lab 6: Closed-loop Position Control, and the Effect of Derivative Control Action
item.description: Lab assignment to investigate closed-loop control of the angular position (θ) of the rotational plant, investigate the manipulation of closed-loop dynamic response through the use of derivative (D), and proportional and derivative (PD) control, and to compare your experimental results with a Simulink digital simulation.

item.title: Lab 7: Closed-Loop Position Control using Position and Velocity Feedback
item.description: Lab assignment to investigate the use of multiple feedback loops, using both position and velocity feedback, investigate the manipulation of closed-loop dynamic response through the use of multiple loops, and compare your experimental results with a Simulink digital simulation.

item.title: Lab Description and Rules
item.description: A brief description of the 2.004 lab facilities and rules.

item.title: Lab: Active Damping of Tall Building Vibrations
item.description: Lab assignment on active damping of tall building vibrations.

item.title: Laboratory Note: Description of the Experimental Rotational Plant
item.description: Lab handout on a physical plant consisting of a rotational flywheel and motor.
